settings.name: randomImpulsesEnabled
settings.label: Enable Random Impulses
settings.description: Uses each included category’s regular Minimum and Maximum sliders. Saved physics values are never overwritten.

settings.name: randomImpulseChancePct
settings.label: Random Impulse Chance (%)
settings.description: Chance that an NPC receives a randomized Min/Max profile. When the roll fails, normal saved values are used.

settings.name: randomDisableGroupsEnabled
settings.label: Randomly Disable Impulse Groups
settings.description: Temporarily removes selected groups for an NPC while leaving the other groups active.

settings.name: randomDisableChancePct
settings.label: Disable Chance (%)
settings.description: Chance that each eligible group is removed, up to the Maximum Groups Disabled limit.

settings.name: randomMaxDisabledGroups
settings.label: Maximum Groups Disabled
settings.description: Maximum number of eligible groups that may be removed. SPLAT always preserves at least one group from the disable pool.

settings.name: advanced
settings.label: Show Advanced Random Pool
settings.description: Choose which groups use Min/Max randomization and which groups may be temporarily disabled.

settings.name: randomPoolHead
settings.label: Head Falls - Include in Random Strength Pool
settings.description: Head uses its existing Head Forward, Fallback, and Rebound Min/Max sliders.

settings.name: randomCanDisableHead
settings.label: Head Falls - Allow Random Disable
settings.description: Allows the randomizer to remove Head Falls for an NPC without changing the saved Head toggles.

settings.name: randomPoolBody
settings.label: Body Falls - Include in Random Strength Pool
settings.description: Uses each Body Falls Minimum and Maximum strength pair.

settings.name: randomCanDisableBody
settings.label: Body Falls - Allow Random Disable
settings.description: Allows the randomizer to remove the main Body Falls lane for an NPC.

settings.name: randomPoolShoulderWaist
settings.label: Shoulder / Butt Falls - Include in Random Strength Pool
settings.description: Uses the shoulder and butt Minimum and Maximum strength pairs.

settings.name: randomCanDisableShoulderWaist
settings.label: Shoulder / Butt Falls - Allow Random Disable
settings.description: Allows only the Shoulder / Butt layer to be removed while Head, Body, and Situational remain available.

settings.name: randomPoolSituational
settings.label: Situational Falls - Include in Random Strength Pool
settings.description: Uses the Standing, Running/Walking, Workspot, Cower, and Stairs Min/Max force pairs.

settings.name: randomCanDisableSituational
settings.label: Situational Falls - Allow Random Disable
settings.description: Allows all situational lanes to be skipped for an NPC while the other impulse systems remain available.
